description: This file defines the interface 'LanguageNegotiatorInterface' for language negotiation services in Drupal, including method signatures and constants related to language negotiation logic.

classes.name: LanguageNegotiatorInterface
classes.description: Interface for language negotiation services, defining methods for managing language negotiation types and methods.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the negotiated languages and the method instances.

methods.name: setCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets the current active user and resets all language types.

methods.name: initializeType
methods.description: Initializes the specified language type and returns the associated language(s).

methods.name: getNegotiationMethods
methods.description: Returns enabled negotiation methods for a given language type.

methods.name: getNegotiationMethodInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of a specific language negotiation method.

methods.name: getPrimaryNegotiationMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the primary negotiation method ID for a language type.

methods.name: isNegotiationMethodEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a negotiation method is enabled for a language type.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the list of enabled negotiation methods for a language type.

methods.name: purgeConfiguration
methods.description: Resaves configuration to remove missing negotiation methods.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates configuration based on provided language types.
